mapper.insert: insert into asc_user_notification_setting ( user_id, push_enabled, cpu_threshold, memory_threshold, notify_node_status, notify_scheduler_fail, notify_build_result, notify_security_alert, notify_command_finish, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{userId}, #{pushEnabled}, #{cpuThreshold}, #{memoryThreshold}, #{notifyNodeStatus}, #{notifySchedulerFail}, #{notifyBuildResult}, #{notifySecurityAlert}, #{notifyCommandFinish}, current_timestamp, current_timestamp )
mapper.update: update asc_user_notification_setting set push_enabled = #{pushEnabled}, cpu_threshold = #{cpuThreshold}, memory_threshold = #{memoryThreshold}, notify_node_status = #{notifyNodeStatus}, notify_scheduler_fail = #{notifySchedulerFail}, notify_build_result = #{notifyBuildResult}, notify_security_alert = #{notifySecurityAlert}, notify_command_finish = #{notifyCommandFinish}, updated_at = current_timestamp where user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: select coalesce(min(cpu_threshold), 85) from asc_user_notification_setting where push_enabled = 'Y'
select coalesce(min(memory_threshold), 85) from asc_user_notification_setting where push_enabled = 'Y'
select * from asc_push_subscription where user_id = #{userId} order by subscription_id desc
select uns.user_id from asc_user_notification_setting uns join asc_user u on uns.user_id = u.user_id where u.status is null or u.status = 'NORMAL' order by uns.user_id asc

select distinct uns.user_id from asc_user_notification_setting uns join asc_user u on uns.user_id = u.user_id join asc_user_role ur on u.user_id = ur.user_id join asc_role_permission rp on ur.role_id = rp.role_id join asc_permission p on rp.perm_id = p.perm_id where (u.status is null or u.status = 'NORMAL') and p.perm_code = #{permission} order by uns.user_id asc
select s.* from asc_push_subscription s join asc_user_notification_setting uns on s.user_id = uns.user_id where uns.push_enabled = 'Y' order by s.subscription_id desc
select count(*) from asc_notification_history where user_id = #{userId} and read_yn = 'N'
mapper.update: update asc_notification_history set read_yn = 'Y' where user_id = #{userId} and read_yn = 'N'
